thread:
morgan: Heads-up: proposing a one-to-one benchmark to isolate kernel selection + kv-cache + batching heuristics. Goal: compare kernels using the exact same prompts + decoding params. Run target: 8k seq, 4k warmup, 256 token gen. @li @nav thoughts?
li: SGTM. We should replay prod traffic + a synthetic prefix-heavy set. Make sure tokenizer alignment: same tokenizer binary + version, and identical stop-seq handling.
morgan: Yep. Plan: use replay harness with utterance set 'one2one_v3' (same prompts), fixed seed, top_p=0.95, temp=0.2, stop=["""]. No dynamic padding.
nav: Also record per-kernel memcpy / cuda kernel times, batch-size distribution, and KV hit/miss counts. Need p50/p95/p99 plus batch composition histogram.
morgan: Proposed command:
```
./harness/run_compare \
  --replay one2one_v3.tar \
  --model t5x-13b-quant \
  --kernel-policy auto,flash,math \
  --kv-cache on,off \
  --batcher continuous,naive \
  --decoding 'temp=0.2,top_p=0.95,stop=""' \
  --seed 42 \
  --outdir /mnt/bench/knobbed-2476
```
bench-bot: Run queued: job id 2476-01. ETA ~45m. Logs: http://ci/2476-01
li: Small ask: add --collect-profiles flame,nvtx,trace and --dump-token-ids=yes so we can validate tokenizer alignment offline. Also capture kernel selection decisions per-request.
morgan: Will add those flags. Also toggling batcher max_batch=32 and mem_limit=6GB so we can map throughput vs latency surface.
nav: If we see a regression vs baseline, bisect by kernel variant and quant path. Reminder: last long-seq regression was with flash kernel + kv=on (seen increased L2 miss).
li: For apples-to-apples, ensure identical model digest and quant params. No on-the-fly re-quant or mixed-path fallbacks during runs.
morgan: Quick snapshot from a toy run (8 threads, tiny subset): p50=120ms, p95=470ms, p99=980ms with kv=on, batcher=continuous, kernel=flash. Raw logs show occasional 20ms memcpy spikes at seq>4k. Will upload full results.
bench-bot: Job 2476-01: finished. Summary: throughput=75 req/s, avg latency=210ms, p95=520ms. Artifacts: /artifacts/2476-01 (profiles + token-dumps).
morgan: Downloading now. First check will be tokens-equality diff across kernel-policy runs. If identical, we can attribute perf delta to kernel/batcher. If not, mark as QA/regression and stop rollout.
li: :thumbsup: If tokens equal and flash still slower at tail, add microbench of memcpy and kernel occupancy. If tokens differ, narrow to tokenizer or decoding edge-case (stop handling).
nav: I'll start a small NVTX-enabled run to capture kernel timelines. Post results in this thread.
morgan: thanks — aim to have a condensed perf-note with graphs and a short recommendation (preferred kernel + batcher combo) by EOD.
